name: skills
description: Portable agent skills, installable as Claude Code plugins.

plugins.name: humanizer
plugins.description: Rewrite prose so it is precise, readable, and naturally human. English by default; Czech, Slovak, Polish, German, and Ukrainian on request. Removes common AI-writing patterns.

plugins.name: diagram-design
plugins.description: Create branded diagrams as standalone HTML/SVG/PNG in 45 visual types, with brand onboarding and draw.io, Mermaid and Excalidraw import.

plugins.name: test-discipline
plugins.description: Test hygiene for changed tests (.spec/.test, Go _test.go, Python test_*.py, Java *Test.java and similar), with severity-graded OK / FIX / DELETE / MISSING reviews.

plugins.name: write-prompt
plugins.description: Write, improve, or translate a prompt: repository context, model-specific guidance from official documentation, and a mandatory independent review.

plugins.name: video-proof
plugins.description: Present completed features through real browser footage with female English narration, bottom subtitles, change highlights, visible clicks, and verified build and Git safety.

plugins.name: animated-diagram
plugins.description: Create looping animated diagrams of service requests, API calls, data pipelines and agent workflows in the diagram-design theme.

plugins.name: orchestrator
plugins.description: Run a task in one main agent loop with an independent review: the main thread scopes, implements and verifies; from fast up a Codex or Claude reviewer reviews the final diff. Use only when the user asks for /orchestrator.
